source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of system testing (PDF 27).

blocks.text: System Testing testing ka ooncha level hai jis mein poore software system ko ek saath (as a whole) test kiya jata hai. Is stage par software ko ek mukammal cheez samjha jata hai, aur testers us ki overall (poori) functionality, performance, security aur di gayi requirements ke mutabiq hona (compliance) jaanchte hain. System testing aise mahol mein ki jati hai jo production environment (asal istemal wala mahol) se bohat milta julta ho, ta ke yaqeen ho ke software asal halaat mein theek chalta hai. Is level par woh defects (khamiyan) pakri jati hain jo system ke mukhtalif hisson ke aapas mein milne se paida hoti hain, aur confirm hota hai ke software apna maqsad poora karta hai.

blocks.prompt: System testing asal jaise (production jaise) mahol mein kyun ki jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Ta ke software un halaat mein jaancha jaye jin ka asal mein samna hoga, aur woh masle samne aayein jo sirf poore system ke asal halaat mein chalne par hote hain.

items: System testing: poora system ek saath; functionality, performance, security, compliance; production jaise mahol mein.
